en: Hmph! None of your business. If you get in our way, we'll simply kill you!

What on earth should I do...?
Wahahaha! Glory to the great Empire!

Nothing surpasses our great cause. Beg for mercy now and we may spare you... Wahahaha!

Damn... Against the Empire, there's no end to it...
Resisting us is futile!
The Crimson Moon King is with us! Wahahaha!

No one can stop our march!
Even if I win this fight, I can't stop them... Damn it!
I fight for the Emperor!
